ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a marine food web diagram, with “Algae” on the left side, and arrows coming from Algae pointing to organisms such as Tiny Shrimps, Butterfly Fish, Limpets, Periwinkles, Sea Slugs, Goby Fish, JellyFish, etc. The diagram also shows other organisms such as Snails, Crabs, Cuttlefish, Sea Urchins, Seaweed, etc., and arrow relationships. Reasoning: The arrows in a food web represent energy or food flowing from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Producers are organisms that can make their own food, are located at the base position of the food web, and provide energy for consumers. In the diagram, Algae is located on the left side and provides energy to many consumers, therefore it is the producer.
